mapper.select: SELECT a.AUTHORITY_ID, a.AUTHORITY_NAME, a.CREATE_DT, a.UPDATE_DT, a.CREATE_ID, a.UPDATE_ID, a.DEL_YN, a.IS_SYSTEM FROM T1000_AUTHORITY a JOIN T1000_AUTHORITY_ACCOUNT aa ON a.AUTHORITY_ID = aa.AUTHORITY_ID WHERE aa.ACCOUNT_ID = #{accountId} AND a.DEL_YN = 'N'
SELECT AUTHORITY_ID, AUTHORITY_NAME, CREATE_DT, UPDATE_DT, CREATE_ID, UPDATE_ID, DEL_YN, IS_SYSTEM FROM T1000_AUTHORITY WHERE DEL_YN = 'N'
